definitions.short: the spread of the fingers, i.e. a span
definitions.full: H2239. zereth זֶ֫רֶת noun feminine span (Late Hebrew id. ( זַרְתָּא ᵑ7 , Syriac ; apparently from Hebrew), etymology dubious; Thes and most derive from √ זרה , see Ol § 146 b but also Sta § 187 a ; Ba ZMG 1887, 607 proposes √ זרה measure off, determine , compare p. 280) — span , as standard of measurement, בַּז ׳שָׁמַיִם תִּכֵּן Isa 40:12 ; elsewhere of actual size, a span , distance between ends of thumb and little finger of spread hand; = 1/2 cubit (see אַמָּה & references; compare Exod 25:10 with Joseph Ant. iii. 6 , 5), ׳ז 28:16 (twice in verse); 39:9 (twice in verse) (all P) Ezek 43:13 ; זָ֑רֶת 1Sam 17:4 six cubits and a span. See Hultsch Metrol. 1882, 443 Benz Archäol. 179 .
